title: Core module with focused tests
purpose: Create or update one Samantha core module with focused unit tests and deterministic verification.
useWhen: The task changes core harness behavior without adding or changing a CLI command.
The behavior can be isolated to one src/core module and one focused test file.
The implementation can be verified with typecheck and Bun tests.

task.title: Implement <module> core behavior
task.instructions: Add the smallest core module implementation that satisfies this task. Start with focused behavior tests in tests/<module>.test.ts, then implement src/core/<module>.ts. Keep the change inside the core module boundary. Do not add CLI surface, remote adapters, daemon/watch behavior, dashboards, routine triggers, hidden memory, or promoted learning artifact edits.
